findings.title: Transaction Count Decline Week-over-Week
findings.claim: Valid transaction count declined 7.38% from 1124 baskets in the previous week to 1041 baskets in the analysis week (Feb 23 - Mar 2, 2026).
coverage_notes: Refunds excluded from transaction count (is_refund == False)
Transaction count based on unique transaction_id values
All valid transactions included in denominator
assumptions: is_refund flag correctly identifies refund transactions
timestamp_utc correctly converts to local time for period filtering

findings.title: Largest Category Revenue Change: iced_other
findings.claim: The iced_other category experienced the largest revenue change at -16.01%, declining from 652.65 SAR to 548.15 SAR between the previous week and analysis week.
coverage_notes: Refunds excluded from category revenue (is_refund == False)
Category totals based on line_total_sar sum
All categories with sales in either period included in comparison
assumptions: is_refund flag correctly identifies refund transactions
line_total_sar represents net revenue per line item

findings.title: Largest SKU Revenue Change: V60 Filter
findings.claim: SKU HOT-004 (V60 Filter) showed the largest revenue change at -34.13%, moving from 2955.70 SAR to 1947.00 SAR between the previous week and analysis week.
coverage_notes: Refunds excluded from SKU revenue (is_refund == False)
SKU revenue based on line_total_sar sum
Only SKUs active in both periods included
Menu join used to verify product names and launch/retire dates
assumptions: is_refund flag correctly identifies refund transactions
line_total_sar represents net revenue per line item
Product was active (post-launch, pre-retire) in both periods
